trusted_context.run_id_rule: Unique host-generated [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,79}, excluding reserved Windows device names; must equal active episode binding
trusted_context.environment_binding_rule: Nonempty unique host environment_instance_id, bound to active run_id and planned task, never reused between modes; provenance checked by host before any call

common_parser_before_policy.host_dependency_parameters_for_full_cata: Use pinned framework public schema excluding every host-injected dependency, not just the two focused examples

rules.argument_constraints: Exactly the empty object; calendar is injected by host

argument_constraints.day: String of exactly 10 ASCII characters YYYY-MM-DD; actual valid Gregorian date, year 0001..9999; no timezone, coercion or whitespace

argument_constraints.query: String of 1..1024 Unicode code points, not entirely whitespace, with no C0 (U+0000..001F) or DEL (U+007F); preserve exact string, no semantic filter, no event-name or expected-answer match
argument_constraints.date: Omitted or null means the documented default None (all dates). Otherwise the same valid YYYY-MM-DD string constraint as day. Preserve raw omission/null in trace and record normalized default separately

rules.argument_constraints: Any request valid against the shared public send_email schema; no allowlist of recipients, subject, body, event or evaluator-derived parameters

enforcement.ALLOW: Record durable decision and execution_start before invoking only the local benchmark runtime; then record result/error
enforcement.BLOCK: No runtime call; durable ADR_POLICY_BLOCK feedback
enforcement.REQUIRE_APPROVAL: No runtime call; durable ADR_APPROVAL_REQUIRED feedback; approval remains false

residual_scope: Allows calendar-wide reads in the episode; not semantic query authorization or final-output DLP. Utility impact and attack efficacy unmeasured; not a deployment certification
